title: Flo Moisture Sensor Low Battery
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flo:event event=sensor_battery
| stats count(eval(battery_pct<20)) as low_battery_sensors by home
| where low_battery_sensors>0
| sort - low_battery_sensors
description: Uses Flo sensor-battery exports telemetry to monitor how many moisture sensors are nearing empty in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for water sensors that may stop protecting vulnerable rooms, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Flo sensor-battery exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Home table of low-battery Flo sensors.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how many moisture sensors are nearing empty so you can spot water sensors that may stop protecting vulnerable rooms before it becomes annoying.
